Pure psilocin is sometimes obtained by synthesizing it in its pure form or extracting it from mushrooms.  This is very rare and you are much much more likely to stumble upon mushrooms.  An average eighth (3.5g) of mushrooms contains around 15mg of pure psilocin.  So you can figure out the dose from that.

The experience usually lasts 4-7 hours total (shorter than LSD), and is characterized by laughing a lot and feeling very relaxed.  There are open and closed eye visuals, pupil dilation, and a general "mindfuck" aspect to it.  It is sometimes referred to as orally active DMT or long-lasting DMT.
